name: Level 60 players queue for Random Burning Crusade Heroic and Mythic without heroic keys, Mythic from item level 70
contract: The realm converts the Burning Crusade dungeons to level 60 and opens them without the reputation heroic keys
(Flamewrought, Reservoir, Warpforged, Auchenai Key, Key of Time) or the attunement quests (Return to Andormu, The
Caverns of Time, Hard to Kill), like their Mythic difficulty. Every specific Heroic in the Random Burning Crusade
Heroic (418) pool is therefore unlocked for a level 60 player who owns no key, and that player queues for 418.
Random Burning Crusade Mythic (419) needs average item level 70 (the realm's choice; the live client asks 108)
and PvE Power 350. Item level is the character sheet's average over every equipment slot but the shirt and
tabard (sixteen while a two-hander is wielded without an off hand). The bcmythic player sits between 70 and 108
with PvE Power 377 and queues; the powered control has PvE Power 362 below item level 70 and is refused.
